objective: Build the staging no-write websiteResolverServiceV1 endpoint wrapper around the local resolver service.

roles.name: Resolver Service Architect
roles.owns: Endpoint wrapper, health endpoint, POST resolve endpoint, local staging server mode, and resolver integration.

roles.name: Security Guard
roles.owns: Auth token validation, strict CORS allowlist, cookie/auth-header rejection, write-payload rejection, rate limits, and redaction.

roles.name: Website Intelligence Agent
roles.owns: Resolver evidence preservation, failure-state honesty, manual-evidence fallback, and source trace integrity.

roles.name: Observability And Reliability Agent
roles.owns: Request traces, cache metadata, latency measurement, health payload, and local staging smoke outputs.

roles.name: Regression Guard Agent
roles.owns: Validator gates proving no writes, no SuiteScript invocation, N/LLM advisory-only, notes story-only, and blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout no-guess behavior.

resolveEndpoint.returns: idb.website-evidence.v1 inside a no-write staging envelope

auth: Reject missing or invalid resolver token before fetch and before cache lookup.
Token is hashed in traces and never logged raw.
cors: Allow only configured NetSuite staging origins.
Approved preflight returns 204 with explicit methods and headers.
Blocked preflight returns 403 without wildcard production CORS.
requestRejection: Reject recordType, recordId, suiteletUrl, scriptId, deployId, writeToken, createEnabled, customerId, proofItemId, transactionId, nlAuth, cookie, and authorization payload fields.
Rejected auth/CORS/write-shaped requests do not fetch websites and do not invoke resolver classification.
redaction: Manual evidence full text is never logged.
Manual evidence is stored as excerpt preview and sha256 hash only.

rules: Do not cache blocked, unavailable, or timeout responses.
Do not cache manual evidence full text.
Return cacheHit true on repeated eligible request.

localStagingRunInstructions: Run npm run harness:hosted-resolver-staging-endpoint for deterministic in-process smoke.

Start the local staging server with IDB_RESOLVER_STAGING_TOKEN=local-staging-token IDB_RESOLVER_ALLOWED_ORIGIN=https://YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID.app.netsuite.com IDB_RESOLVER_STAGING_PORT=8787 node tools/website_resolver_staging_endpoint.js.
Point the drawer pilot toggle to http://127.0.0.1:8787/idb/website-resolver/v1/resolve only for local staging.
Clear the endpoint toggle to roll back.

bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W70: Drawer Hosted Resolver Endpoint Toggle Smoke. Wire and prove the drawer pilot toggle path against the local staging websiteResolverServiceV1 endpoint: endpoint URL setting, token/header strategy placeholder, hosted-only mode, local fallback rollback, Plan/Review resolver status display, failure-state UX, trace export coverage, and no-write/no-SuiteScript/N/LLM-advisory-only gates. Keep notes story-only and blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout as insufficient evidence with no confident guesses. Output drawer toggle smoke artifacts, trace samples, W70 report, validator gates, and best next Codex prompt.
